postal_system.assignment_rule: The Universal Postal Union September 2025 Universal DataBase lists Curaçao among countries and territories which do not require postal codes. Current Cpost International service pages describe delivery to an address in Curaçao and postal boxes without publishing a postcode field, code assignment or code table. A four-digit validator, commerce ZIP field, international sender placeholder, AGID planning code or locality identifier is not a Curaçao postal-code assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postal-code assignments exist to anchor postal-code Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Island, district, administrative, locality, neighbourhood, cadastral, address, delivery-route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as official, derived or virtual postal-code area geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. Box, street name, house or building number, unit, locality and Curaçao as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated four-digit postal code into domestic addresses. International commerce forms that require a ZIP field are application constraints, not Cpost authority.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal boxes, registered-mail pickup, street delivery, courier, route or other service objects independently. A non-area object never becomes a postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative code assignment and reviewed geometry relationship.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A locality label, route, district, parcel, coordinate, proximity or synthetic CW code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-postcode or independently typed context for CW, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. CW planning cells and crosswalks may index separately authorized administrative, address, route or building evidence, but they are never Cpost codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed Cpost International page asserts 2026 copyright and publishes no open postal dataset licence. UPU material is reference evidence only. No processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving right for a postal dataset is inferred from web access.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO CW identity. Do not merge Curaçao with Aruba, Sint Maarten, Caribbean Netherlands, the former Netherlands Antilles or the Netherlands, and do not borrow their assignments or geometry.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, recipients, P.O. Box holders, registered-mail observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs can expose personal or property context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode status is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, publication or edition, exact bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when Cpost International or UPU announces a Curaçao postal-code system. Never rewrite historical evidence as timeless.

stages.definition: Curaçao address-format inventory, draft planning pack and synthetic test vectors only.
Digest-bound Cpost International and UPU evidence that Curaçao currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, identity, privacy, address-format correction and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Cpost International or competent public release establishing a Curaçao postal-code system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU September 2025 list records Curaçao among countries and territories which do not require postal codes; current Cpost service pages publish address, postal-box and pickup services but no code assignment or code table. Absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Curaçao remains ISO CW and must not inherit Aruba, Sint Maarten, Caribbean Netherlands, former-Netherlands-Antilles or Netherlands assignments or geometry. Islands, districts, administrative areas, localities, neighbourhoods, addresses, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells, commerce ZIP placeholders, unverified four-digit validators and synthetic CW planning codes are prohibited proxies. Postal-box, registered-mail pickup, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real CW API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: CW metadata, no-postcode policy, address-format correction and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real CW Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual CW loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Curaçao postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, address, route, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
